title: IPConnection
description: IP Connect is a client-side Fabric mod that allows you to quickly switch servers using local commands, without sending them to the current server.
body:
### IPConnection

IPConnection is a client-side only Fabric mod for Minecraft that allows safe and controlled server connection management, without relying on commands sent to the current server.

The mod intercepts and handles the connection logic directly on the client, enabling clean disconnections, automatic reconnections, and IP switching without causing network errors, desynchronization, or forced game closures.

It is designed for environments that require precise control over the connection flow, such as networks, multi-instance servers, or technical testing setups.

Key features

100% client-side server switching

Safe disconnection from the current world before reconnecting

Prevents commands from being sent to the server

Proper handling of network states and connection screens

Compatible with Fabric and modern Minecraft versions

Lightweight, stable, and performance-friendly

Focus

IPConnection prioritizes stability, clean transitions, and full control over the connection process, making it ideal for advanced users, developers, testers, and players who frequently move between servers.
